acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce or bound the failure under parallel load (host, Go version, run count, observed descendant lifetime).
The settle check either waits on an observed exit signal rather than a fixed deadline, or reports the slow descendant as a named NOT_OBSERVED outcome; a descendant that truly survives still fails.
body: Observed 2026-10-04 on darwin during the issue 395 postmergeproof slice (PR 564) under parallel package load: internal/opencodequalification TestPassiveWitnessSettle/AHI-032 failed because a descendant was still alive at the context deadline, then passed when rerun alone. Suspected timing sensitivity in the settle deadline; related history V1-0534 (issue 387, qualify-opencode timing) is COMPLETED. Not confirmed as a product defect.
title: tests: TestPassiveWitnessSettle/AHI-032 sees a live descendant at the context deadline under parallel load (suspected flake)
